title: Collective Dynamics in Circuit Quantum Acoustodynamics with a Macroscopic Resonator
summary: Collective dynamics in engineered quantum systems offer a unique and versatile platform for exploring how many-body correlations bridge microscopic entanglement and macroscopic behavior. In this work, we report collective Dicke dynamics of acoustic modes in a macroscopic high-overtone bulk acoustic resonator (HBAR). To achieve this, we engineer a hybrid quantum acoustodynamic system comprising an HBAR strongly coupled to a superconducting transmon qubit.
